# proxmox_cluster_realm_sync_jobs (Data Source)

Lists the scheduled realm sync jobs of the cluster from `/cluster/jobs/realm-sync`, sorted by realm.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_cluster_realm_sync_jobs" "all" {}
```
